Body.Content:
Here are the Azure Firewall updates for September 2019.

- Azure Firewall is now generally available in China—For more information, please see the Product page and Pricing page.

- Azure Firewall is now ISO compliant—Azure Firewall is now Payment Card Industry (PCI), Service Organization Controls (SOC), and International Organization for Standardization (ISO) compliant. It currently supports SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, SOC 3, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001, 27018, 20000-1, 22301, 9001, and 27017. For more information, see the Microsoft Compliance Guide.
